description: Everything openly available around a paper, in ONE call: full text, license, datasets, code, and citations. Given a DOI, PMID, or arXiv id, walks paper (Crossref + OpenAlex) -> open copies with PER-COPY license and version (Unpaywall + PubMed Central — never collapses "free to read" into "permitted to reuse") -> datasets that cite it (DataCite relatedIdentifiers) -> code/materials that implement it (Zenodo, Hugging Face Papers) -> papers that cite it (Semantic Scholar, falling back to OpenAlex's citation graph if Semantic Scholar is rate-limited or returns nothing — `citing.source` says which one answered) -> retraction status (Crossref/Retraction Watch). Use for "what datasets/code are linked to <DOI>", "is this paper retracted", "find an open copy of <DOI> and its license", "who has cited <paper>". Each leg is independently fetched — a slow/dead upstream is listed in sources_failed rather than failing the whole call.

arxiv_id.description: arXiv id, e.g. "2312.00752". Resolved to arXiv's own DataCite DOI (10.48550/arXiv.<id>) — best-effort for pre-2022 papers.

doi.description: DOI of the paper, e.g. "10.1038/s41586-020-2649-2" (a doi.org URL is also accepted).

max_citing.description: Max citing papers to return (1-25, default 10).

max_datasets.description: Max datasets to return (1-100, default 25). DataCite's `total` count is always returned even when truncated.

pmid.description: PubMed ID, e.g. "32015507". Resolved to a DOI via NCBI's ID Converter.

name: research_chain
